text: 2.1 Passwords are hashed with bcrypt at a cost factor of 12.
verdictDetail: src/passwords.mjs:1,3 uses scryptSync with N=16384, not bcrypt. Algorithm is scrypt, not bcrypt.

text: 2.2 The minimum password length is 12 characters.
verdictDetail: src/validation.mjs:1 sets PASSWORD_MIN = 10, not 12.

text: 2.3 The maximum password length is 128 characters.
verdictDetail: src/validation.mjs:2 PASSWORD_MAX = 128; enforced at src/validation.mjs:24.

text: 2.4 Passwords on the common-password list are refused.
verdictDetail: src/validation.mjs:5 defines COMMON set; src/validation.mjs:30 rejects matches.

text: 2.5 A password may not contain the local part of the user's email address.
verdictDetail: src/validation.mjs:27-28 extracts local part and pushes 'contains_email' if present.

text: 3.1 An account locks after five consecutive failed login attempts.
verdictDetail: src/login.mjs:4 MAX_ATTEMPTS=5; src/login.mjs:20 `if (state.count >= MAX_ATTEMPTS)` triggers lock.

text: 3.2 A lock lasts 15 minutes.
verdictDetail: src/login.mjs:5 LOCK_MS = 15*60*1000; src/login.mjs:21 lockedUntil = clock() + LOCK_MS.

text: 3.3 The response to an unknown email is identical to the response to a wrong password.
verdictDetail: src/login.mjs:18 single branch `if (!user || !verifyPassword(...))` returns `{ok:false,reason:'invalid_credentials'}` for both cases.

text: 3.4 A user whose email address is not verified cannot log in.
verdictDetail: src/login.mjs:29 `if (!user.emailVerified) return {ok:false,reason:'unverified'}`.

text: 4.1 Access tokens are signed with HMAC-SHA256.
verdictDetail: src/tokens.mjs:1,11 createHmac('sha256', key) — algorithm is HS256 as confirmed by header b64({alg:'HS256'}).

text: 4.2 Access tokens expire 15 minutes after they are issued.
verdictDetail: src/tokens.mjs:4 ACCESS_TTL_SECONDS = 3600 (1 hour). Was 900 (15 min) in v2.2.0; changed in commit 1838534 'Longer access tokens for the mobile client'.

text: 4.3 Tokens declaring any algorithm other than HS256 are refused.
verdictDetail: src/tokens.mjs:34 `if (header.alg !== 'HS256') return {valid:false,reason:'bad_alg'}`.

text: 4.4 Up to 30 seconds of clock skew is tolerated.
verdictDetail: src/tokens.mjs:5 CLOCK_SKEW_SECONDS = 30; applied at lines 39-40.

text: 4.5 Refresh tokens are single use, and reusing one revokes its whole token family.
verdictDetail: src/refresh.mjs:20-22: if rec.used, marks all family tokens used:true and returns 'reused'.

text: 4.6 Refresh tokens expire after 30 days.
verdictDetail: src/refresh.mjs:4 REFRESH_TTL_MS = 30*24*60*60*1000; enforced at src/refresh.mjs:24.

text: 5.1 A session ends after 30 minutes without activity.
verdictDetail: src/sessions.mjs:3 IDLE_MS = 30*60*1000; enforced at src/sessions.mjs:20.

text: 5.2 A session ends 12 hours after login, whatever the activity.
verdictDetail: src/sessions.mjs:4 ABSOLUTE_MS = 12*60*60*1000; enforced at src/sessions.mjs:21.

text: 5.3 A user may hold at most five concurrent sessions. Starting a sixth ends the oldest.
verdictDetail: src/sessions.mjs has no session count cap. createSessionStore() allows unlimited sessions per user; no eviction of oldest.

text: 6.1 Each client IP may make 100 requests a minute. Further requests are refused with a retry time.
verdictDetail: src/ratelimit.mjs:1-2 LIMIT=100, WINDOW_MS=60000; src/ratelimit.mjs:16 returns {allowed:false,retryAfter:...}.

text: 7.1 Reset links expire after one hour and work once.
verdictDetail: src/reset.mjs:5 RESET_TTL_MS=60*60*1000; src/reset.mjs:28 tokens.delete(h(token)) after first use.

text: 7.2 Completing a reset ends every active session for the account.
verdictDetail: src/reset.mjs:30 sessions?.destroyAllFor(rec.email); added in commit 2d435d7 and CHANGELOG 2.3.0.

text: 8.1 Every failed login is recorded with the client IP address.
verdictDetail: src/login.mjs:26 audit({type:'login.failed',email:key,ip}) — ip is included.

text: 8.2 Passwords are never written to the audit log.
verdictDetail: src/audit.mjs:5 destructures `{password,newPassword,...safe}` stripping both password fields before storing.

text: 9.1 Verification links expire after 24 hours.
verdictDetail: src/verify.mjs:3 VERIFY_TTL_MS = 24*60*60*1000; enforced at src/verify.mjs:17.

text: ✔ R-01 All automated tests pass on main.
verdictDetail: npm test (Stage 4): 62/62 tests pass on main branch.

text: ✔ R-02 Every automated case in the test plan has a passing automated test.
verdictDetail: Stage 2 found no mapped test for 24 of 84 automated cases (e.g. TP-003, TP-011, TP-018, TP-036, TP-038, TP-039 …). Coverage is ~71%. Rule A: 'every' claim fails on counterexample.

text: ✔ R-03 CHANGELOG lists every behaviour change since 2.2.0.
verdictDetail: Rule A: 'every' claim fails on a counterexample. CHANGELOG.md 2.3.0 omits the token TTL change (15 min → 1 hour, commit 1838534). At least one behaviour change is unlisted — 'every' cannot hold.

text: ✔ R-04 package.json version matches the release tag.
verdictDetail: package.json version:"2.3.0" matches git tag v2.3.0.

text: ✔ R-05 No new runtime dependencies.
verdictDetail: package.json dependencies:{} in both v2.2.0 and v2.3.0. git diff v2.2.0 v2.3.0 -- package.json shows no dependency additions.

text: ✔ R-06 No TODO or FIXME comments left in src/.
verdictDetail: src/ratelimit.mjs:6 contains `// FIXME: buckets are never pruned, so memory grows with every distinct IP seen.` — added in commit cdb5818.

text: ✔ R-07 README documents every environment variable the service reads.
verdictDetail: README.md Configuration table lists TURNSTILE_SECRET and TURNSTILE_ISSUER — the only two env vars in src/config.mjs:3-4.

text: ✔ R-08 Licence file present and matches package.json.
verdictDetail: LICENSE file present (MIT License header). package.json license:"MIT". Both match.

text: ✔ R-09 SECURITY.md names a contact for vulnerability reports.
verdictDetail: SECURITY.md:3 names security@turnstile.example as the vulnerability contact.

text: ✔ R-10 The authentication spec has been reviewed against the implementation.
verdictDetail: Rule B: claim attests the spec was reviewed against the implementation. This audit's own verdicts show SP-001 FAILS (bcrypt claimed, scrypt used), SP-002 FAILS (min length 12 claimed, 10 in code), SP-011 FAILS (15-min TTL claimed, 1-hour in code), SP-018 FAILS (5-session cap claimed, no cap in code). A proper review would have found these. The attestation is contradicted by audit evidence.

text: Release gate: Met
verdictDetail: Rule B: 'Release gate: Met' attests all checklist items passed. This audit's own verdicts contradict that: CL-002 FAILS (24 automated cases unmapped, Rule A), CL-003 FAILS (token TTL change missing from CHANGELOG, Rule A), CL-006 FAILS (FIXME in src/ratelimit.mjs:6), CL-010 FAILS (spec review attestation contradicted by SP-001/SP-002/SP-011/SP-018 FAILS, Rule B). Release gate cannot be Met.
